objective: Audit the current main-branch Park MVP readiness against the supplied Park acceptance requirements; trace application observation-source wiring; record bounded BTS-to-DR24 Lightcurves availability evidence; identify the application-level DR24 acquisition gap and define a fail-closed implementation sequence without changing scientific baselines.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Park MVP is the primary delivery track; CPVS exact-reconstruction is excluded from this delivery track.
The v0.2.0 scientific baseline and v1.0.1 package release are immutable.
The bounded BTS-to-DR24 pilot is candidate recovery and row-availability evidence, not physical identity or scientific validation.
The application observation service currently uses the ALeRCE detection backend.
The user requires provenance, reproducibility, traceability, and no unsupported completion claims.

baseline.description: Read-only audit of current main. No application runtime, model, data, benchmark, feature schema, taxonomy, scientific threshold, or release was modified.

correctness.before: Park requirements, application source wiring, and DR24 pilot evidence were not recorded together as a current application-readiness matrix.
correctness.after: The audit maps relevant source files and records that the default application observation path is ALeRCE-backed while the DR24 pilot remains separate.

reliability.reason: No application-level DR24 acquisition adapter or end-to-end DR24 Workbench run was executed.

reproducibility.before: The bounded DR24 pilot evidence was not mapped to the application acceptance path.
reproducibility.after: The audit records the 100-target, 773-OID, 714-found/59-missing availability evidence and its limitations, and identifies the missing application integration.
reproducibility.reason: The source-backed pilot is bounded and reproducible by its own workflow record; no end-to-end Park application run manifest exists.

scientific_validity.reason: The audit does not measure photometry quality, physical identity, classification performance, calibration, anomaly performance, or independent temporal validation.

regression_protection_count.reason: This cycle records a read-only audit and creates no runtime code or tests.

measurement.trade_off: Prioritize the explicit DR24 application acquisition gap and bounded adapter integration over larger data downloads, optional CIN runtime, or unrelated scientific workstreams.

evidence: Inspected ObservationService, API application wiring, ALeRCE normalization, local ingestion, DR24 source-subset normalization, feature pipeline, job executor, and Workbench entry files.
Verified that ObservationService constructs AlerceDetectionBackend directly and the API creates the default ObservationService with Alerce().

Verified the recorded DR24 pilot counts: 773 recovered OIDs queried, 714 Lightcurves rows found, 59 missing, 773/773 filter metadata pairs consistent, and 87/100 BTS targets with at least one g and one r OID.
Created an acceptance matrix that separates verified bounded evidence from partial, blocked, and not-started Park requirements.
No runtime code, model artifact, feature schema, benchmark, production data, or release was changed.

root_causes: The default application observation service is wired directly to ALeRCEDetectionBackend rather than a source-selectable DR24 adapter.
The existing DR24 work is a separate recovery/availability workflow and has not been integrated into application observation retrieval.
unresolved: DR24 Lightcurves schema and photometry mapping require a pinned source-specific contract.
Object/filter/field/CCD/quadrant grouping and identity semantics require fixture-backed tests.
Photometry quality, cadence, temporal coverage, and per-filter completeness remain unmeasured.
No 100,000-light-curve labeled Park dataset has been produced or validated.
No end-to-end DR24 Workbench demo, Park run bundle, or clean-machine deployment acceptance has been verified.

findings: The DR24 pilot is useful for adapter design but does not establish scientific validation.
DR24 must be an explicit selectable source and must not silently fall back to ALeRCE.
The frozen v0.2.0 feature contract must remain unchanged during acquisition integration.
A bounded pinned sample and complete provenance should precede any large-scale retrieval.

open_blockers: No DR24 application adapter or regression suite was implemented in this audit.
No end-to-end DR24 API/Workbench workflow was executed.
No photometry-quality or independent temporal scientific validation was performed.

knowledge_carried_forward: Park MVP is the primary delivery track.
Implement a source-selectable DR24 Lightcurves adapter behind the application observation boundary.
Keep ALeRCE selectable and prohibit silent source fallback.
Use fixture-backed regression tests and bounded source-backed integration runs.
Do not increase product progress or scientific readiness based on this documentation-only audit.
Keep CPVS outside the Park MVP scope and CIN runtime off the critical path.
